<div class="card-body">
'''High Anxiety''' is a [[Dark]] [[Effect]] ([[Immediate Effect]]) from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">＊安否を気遣う心</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">相手の能力値＞２のキャラクターが行方不明になった直後に、同じ星にいる能力値＞２の反乱軍に配備する。その反乱軍は戦闘から完全に除外される。行方不明のキャラクターが発見されるかロストしたなら、即効エフェクトはロストする。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-High-Anxiety-PSA-154944000.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">１人の反乱軍が行方不明になったとしても、同盟軍の指揮官たちは沈着冷静に行動せねばならない。とはいえ、心穏やかでない者がいるのも事実。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' A heart anxious for their safety.

'''Card text:'''
Use immediately after an opponent's character with ability > 2 becomes missing. Deploy on a Rebel with ability > 2 on the same planet. That Rebel is completely excluded from battle. The Immediate Effect is lost if the missing character is found or lost.

'''Lore:'''
Even if one Rebel goes missing, Alliance commanders must stay calm. Still, some are not at peace.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[High Anxiety]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
